'''Ziemowit Skwara''' (GEMP handle '''Kryptofis''') is a member of [[Team 5]] in Poland<ref name="slack-2021">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Joe Olson (arebelspy), 14 January 2021 and 12 January 2023</ref>. Kryptofis is the Username on his [[2012 World Championship]] Xerox sheets. He finished '''#13''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Round of 16; Challonge seed 19).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>
